seoTitle: Gérard & Fils - Request a free quote for your move
seoDesc: Moving a piano, your home or your offices in Brussels or elsewhere in Belgium? Request a free, accurate removal quote.

intro.p: Need a quote for your move in the Brussels region? Trust Gérard & Fils. Whether you are an individual or a business, and whether your move is national or international, we support you through every stage of your project. Whether it is a full or partial move, with or without a furniture lift, our team takes care of the whole organisation, from planning through to completion, even in the most complex cases, such as transporting bulky or fragile items like a piano.
For a personalised estimate, please fill in the form below, giving us the details of your request. We will send you a clear, complete quote tailored to your needs as quickly as possible.
To make things easier, you can use our volume calculator and enter the result at the bottom of the form. ("Volume to be moved" field of the form)
